newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: RESEARCH ALERT-SEOULBANK upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SEOULBANK upgraded to buy.

text.p: Ssangyong Securities said on Monday it has upgraded its recommendation for SEOULBANK to "buy" from "hold" because the company share price was at historical lows.
The securities house said in a report the bank's shares were currently trading at the lowest level seen in almost 10 years.
In March 1987, the stock was trading at 4,750 won.
Ssangyong also said the possibility of mergers and acquisitions in the banking industry beginning in 1997 also made the shares more attractive.
SEOULBANK shares were among the most actively traded on Monday. It closed up 300 won to 5,410, on volume of 1.4 million shares.
